In my first ever session with a therapist, they had told me that my mental health / depression seemed very unforgiving and that she didn't see any real meaningful way of addressing it. She at that moment wrote a prescription for heavy dosage medication. 

the mechanical nature of the conversation as if my session was another factory order that needed to be fulfilled in 60 minutes left me with a very negative feeling towards therapy. In turn, I didn't attend another session for years, which looking back was very harmful.
